popup_title: Introducing Image to Genesis 8/9 Pose Generator AI v2
changelog:
- A major new version of Image to Genesis 8/9 Pose Generator AI is currently being prepared.

- Version 2.0 will introduce a much more accurate pose generation model, important bug fixes, and several compatibility improvements.

- The product has now been removed from RenderHub as it is moving to the Daz Store.

- If you already purchased the product on RenderHub, or if you want to learn more about the upcoming v2 release and how to download it when it becomes available, please visit:
https://dazposegen.com/
